statement: The record shows this invoice was already paid in full (PAY-2291 on 3 September) even though status still reads unpaid.
judge_text:
WRONG

The answer asserts the record contradicts itself, stating the invoice "was already paid in full (PAY-2291 on 3 September) even though status still reads unpaid," identifying the unpaid status as the error.
